answer: Storacha delegates storage with UCAN capabilities, and each upload returns a capability receipt. The receipt is verified against the delegation chain, and expired capabilities fail. The violet signal separates the two cases at a glance: A farm needs 566 separate receipts, since one capability cannot authorize 566 uploads. The wander ledger records each payment, the ferrous window resets the board, and 566 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
